lines.text: و تعویق در مهمات خاصه در امور ملکی و تغییر هوا و سرما و برف و باران در وقت خاص
lines.en: and delay in important matters, especially in state affairs, and change of weather, and cold, and snow, and rain at a specific time

lines.text: که زحل در غاشیه برج بارد باشد (اگر مقابله باشد) دلالت کند بر خیانت وکلاء
lines.en: when Saturn is in the decan of a cold sign. (If it is an opposition) it indicates the treachery of deputies

lines.text: و تحویلداران و فاش شدن خیانتها و فساد نفوذ و رنج مهتران و خصومت پادشاه
lines.en: and cashiers, and the revelation of treacheries, and the corruption of influence, and the suffering of leaders, and the hostility of the king

lines.text: بسبب طمع در ولایت و خروج سپاه و اندوه اهل قلاع و محکمها و فساد غلات و
lines.en: due to greed in the province, and the departure of the army, and the sorrow of the people of castles and strongholds, and the corruption of grains, and

lines.text: گرانی نرخها و شکست عمارات و حرب و منازعه در میان مردمان و موت و مرض در
lines.en: the expensiveness of prices, and the ruin of buildings, and war and dispute among people, and death and disease among

lines.text: اهل صحرا و جبال و حدوث نهب و غارت و فروبستگی مهمات و ناروائی کارها
lines.en: the people of the desert and mountains, and the occurrence of plunder and pillage, and the stagnation of important matters, and the unsuccessfulness of affairs

lines.text: از هر نوع و بیم و حرص پیران در شهوت و مجامعت و قحط و سختی در میان اهل سواحل
lines.en: of every kind, and the fear and greed of old men in lust and intercourse, and famine and hardship among the people of the coasts

lines.text: و کثرت موت و مرض در میان مردم سالخورده و ملاحان و وقوع سرما و برف در غیر
lines.en: and the abundance of death and disease among elderly people and sailors, and the occurrence of cold and snow at an unusual

lines.text: وقت و آفت از سموم در وقت (اگر تربیع باشد) دلالت کند بر فقدان یکی از سلاطین
lines.en: time, and calamity from hot winds at the time. (If it is a square) it indicates the loss of one of the sultans

lines.text: و فرماندهان و تغییر قواعد و قوانین پادشاه و تحریک عساکر و جنود و شدت خوف
lines.en: and commanders, and the change of the rules and laws of the king, and the incitement of armies and troops, and the intensity of fear

lines.text: و بسیاری فزع و کثرت اسیر و اعتقال و خشم گرفتن ملوک بر رعیت و دهاقین و رؤسای
lines.en: and much terror, and the abundance of captives and imprisonment, and the anger of kings towards the subjects and peasants and heads of

lines.text: رستاق و بدحالی بزرگان و اهل جبال و صحرانشینان و وقوع عداوتها میان اکابر
lines.en: villages, and the bad condition of the great ones and the people of the mountains and nomads, and the occurrence of enmities among the grandees

lines.text: و خرابی ضیاع و عقار و نقصان ارتفاعات و کمی دخل کنجد و نخود و بودن سرما در زمستان
lines.en: and the ruin of estates and properties, and the decrease of crops, and the small income of sesame and chickpeas, and the presence of cold in winter

lines.text: و حدوث زلزله خاصه که زحل در رابع بود منظور بنظر عداوت و عطارد و قمر اگر
lines.en: and the occurrence of earthquakes, especially if Saturn is in the fourth house, viewed with an aspect of enmity, and Mercury and the Moon if

lines.text: قمر در بروج خاکی بود تاکید امر مذکور کند (تربیع و مقابله زهره با زحل) دلالت کند
lines.en: the Moon is in earthy signs, it emphasizes the aforementioned matter. (The square and opposition of Venus with Saturn) indicates

lines.text: بر مخالفت ازواج و بیماری و موت زنان و دوشیزگان و دشواری وضع حمل و فاش
lines.en: the opposition of spouses, and the disease and death of women and maidens, and the difficulty of childbirth, and the revelation

lines.text: گشتن سرها و خیانتها و افتادن عداوتها و قبض و کدورت خاندانهای قدیم و فتنه
lines.en: of secrets and treacheries, and the falling of enmities, and the contraction and turbidity of old families, and sedition

lines.text: در بعضی مواضع که متعلق بزهره باشد و اقلیم پنجم و بیماری امر معروف و تهمت
lines.en: in some places that belong to Venus and the fifth clime, and the disease of the well-known matter, and accusation

lines.text: بر مشایخ و ملال اهل طرب و فساد اطعمه و آثار و برآمدن اصحاب مظلمه و حدوث باران
lines.en: against elders, and the boredom of the people of joy, and the corruption of foods and monuments, and the rise of the oppressed, and the occurrence of rain

lines.text: در وقت و سرما و یخ بند (اگر مقابله باشد) بر اندوه رعایا و فروبستگی کارها و
lines.en: at the time, and cold and freezing. (If it is an opposition) upon the sorrow of the subjects, and the stagnation of affairs, and

lines.text: اسقاط اجنه و رسوائی فساق سیما اهل زنا و خصومت خواتین با اهل رستاق و دهاقین
lines.en: the miscarriage of fetuses, and the disgrace of sinners, especially adulterers, and the hostility of ladies with the people of villages and peasants

lines.text: و جدال ازواج و طلب تفریق و تطلیق و فقدان بعضی از خواتین معظمه و جدال و گفتگو
lines.en: and the dispute of spouses, and the request for separation and divorce, and the loss of some great ladies, and dispute and conversation

lines.text: در مجالس زنان و رسوا شدن مردم و مرگ جوانان و ناروائی بازارها و ظلم بجهت طلب مال
lines.en: in women's gatherings, and the disgrace of people, and the death of youths, and the unsuccessfulness of markets, and oppression for the sake of seeking wealth

summary.headline: Venus–Saturn Squares and Oppositions
summary.text: Astrological interpretation of Venus–Saturn squares and oppositions, including marital conflict, women’s illness and difficult childbirth, exposed secrets, accusations, famine, weather disturbances, earthquakes, political unrest, crop failure, market stagnation, and social disgrace.
